author: Vineeth Kartha
name: vin_stackwithShineStacker
description: Sends two or more selected photos to the Shine Stacker focus-stacking tool (via Python) and returns a combined image.
description-extensive: Sends at least two selected photos to the Shine Stacker focus-stacking program and returns one combined, fully-sharp image. It requires Python and the Shine Stacker script to be set up, and the author notes it may need adjusting to work on your system.
